workflows.name: q_daily_scan
workflows.purpose: Daily 7AM PT: stamp Pipeline Control!B35 so the Mac poller runs W7 — Q Designs rows the VA flips to 'Design For Review' get fetched, researched (EverBee+eRank), planned, built as drafts on both shops with the hardened ink/niche/hero rules, audited, and flipped to Done. Poller self-stamps at 07:00 as fallback if this workflow is down.

workflows.name: listing_watch
workflows.purpose: Every 2 minutes (David, 2026-09-08: the tick cadence was the slowest part of a batch): stamp Pipeline Control!B38 so the Mac poller runs W8 — scripts/listing_watcher.py takes the lowest TO DO / Draft Partial R row whose teardown gate is green and runs run_batch (one SKU, --workers 1) from the RELEASE worktree; parks with BLOCKED + Slack. Never activates a listing.

workflows.name: slack_verdicts
workflows.purpose: Every 2 min: read #etsy-shop-alerts (bot 'Etsy Design System'), take David's 'approve Rnnn' / 'revise Rnnn: notes' messages, and record them on that R row — STATUS Design For Review -> Ready for Mock-up / Revise, verbatim words in Approval/Revision Notes — then confirm in the channel. Rows not waiting for a verdict get an explanation, never a write.

workflows.name: codex_test_watch
workflows.purpose: Every 2 minutes: stamp Pipeline Control!C38 so the Mac poller runs the isolated Codex test lane against R Designs - Codex Test. Only R8000-R8999 rows are accepted.

workflows.name: codex_test_verdicts
workflows.file: Etsy Design System - Codex Test Verdicts.json

workflows.purpose: Every 2 minutes: apply Slack approve/revise/reject verdicts for R8000-R8999 to the R Designs - Codex Test tab only.
